search_budget: one fixed specification per arm, no tuning or winner selection
calibration: side-specific multiplicative mean correction, prior mass=20 expected events; fit calibration segment only
total_distribution: sum of independent calibrated side Poissons; dependence unvalidated
hypothesis: H: kernel-weighted historical own production against opponents similar in pre-fixture target concession and shot concession; deterministic scale, shrink to unconditional production
hypothesis_dimensions_scale: (1+abs(target current opponent profile)) per dimension; no learned future scales
primary: paired binary log-loss M2 minus M2+H; report M1 minus M2 too
promotion: disabled; no protected holdout, verified market layer or preregistered confirmation tolerances
period_policy: exclude ambiguous/extra-time all stats; quarantine additive mismatch cells and duplicates; do not repair values
market_state: MARKET_UNTESTED; yellow card proxy not market equivalent
reason: V1 corners/cards could not fit due to early-history support; preserve V1 and use later coverage-selected development fold; no corner/card model outcomes inspected before this specification.
